verdict.rationale: Pipedream has a reusable component model: source-available triggers and actions can be dropped into workflows, and developers can build components locally with the CLI (`pd dev`/`pd deploy`) or contribute new ones via GitHub. That gives some support for reusable modules. However, the evidence never shows one workflow calling another as a sub-workflow, nor publishing private reusable modules for other workflows to invoke. Missing for 10: documented sub-workflow invocation between workflows, private reusable action/module authoring and sharing for workflows, independent or hands-on corroboration.
